title: Chicago & Indiana Dunes
subtitle: Jun 27–28, 2026, with Michael. A redeye into O’Hare, Pullman and Emmett Till in one stop and the Indiana Dunes on Saturday, then the Shedd, the Field Museum and the Pokémon fossil exhibit on Sunday before the flight home.

days.label: Day 0
days.title: Redeye to Chicago
days.html:
✈︎

SFO → ORD overnight

American AA 2554 · SFO 11:10 PM Fri → ORD 5:39 AM Sat · seats 32A & 32B · conf. WRPPLZ.

Rental car from O’Hare. Michael joins both days.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Pullman and the Dunes
days.sub: O’Hare → Hermosa → Pullman → South Loop → Indiana Dunes → Chinatown → downtown
days.cut: Pullman’s visitor center gives two stamps at one desk: Pullman NHP and Emmett Till & Mamie Till-Mobley NM. Indiana Dunes is on Central time too, at the Porter visitor center.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Museum Campus, then home
days.sub: Downtown → Hermosa → Shedd → Field Museum → O’Hare
days.cut: The Shedd and the Field Museum share Museum Campus: park once at Soldier Field North Garage and walk between them.

stops.via: Land, pick up the rental, west side to Hermosa.
stops.name: Pick up Michael
stops.note: An early start after the redeye. Time to spare before Pullman opens at 10.

stops.via: Down the Dan Ryan (I-94) to 111th St.
stops.name: Pullman NHP
stops.addr: Pullman National Historical Park Visitor Center, 610 E 111th St, Chicago, IL

also.name: Emmett Till & Mamie Till-Mobley NM
also.where: Same desk at the Pullman visitor center

stops.ok: Fully wheelchair accessible. Exhibits on the company town and the 1894 strike.
stops.about: George Pullman’s planned factory town for railcar workers, and the birthplace of the Brotherhood of Sleeping Car Porters.

stops.via: Back north to the South Loop.
stops.name: Deep-dish lunch
stops.addr: Lou Malnati's Pizzeria, 805 S State St, Chicago, IL
stops.note: Lou Malnati’s or Giordano’s. Deep dish takes ~45 minutes to bake, so order as soon as you sit down.

stops.via: Leave about 1:15. East on I-90 (the Skyway) into Indiana.
stops.name: Indiana Dunes NP
stops.addr: Indiana Dunes Visitor Center, 1215 N State Road 49, Porter, IN
stops.ok: New park for the 64. Then down to the Lake Michigan beach.
stops.about: Fifteen miles of Lake Michigan shoreline with dunes, wetlands and prairie, one of the most biodiverse corners of the park system.

stops.via: Leave about 3:30. Back west on I-90/94.
stops.name: Early dinner in Chinatown
stops.note: Noodles in the Chinatown food court. Then drop Michael in Hermosa.

stops.name: Downtown Chicago
stops.note: Check in and rest; you’ve been up since yesterday.

stops.name: Pick up Michael
stops.note: No breakfast stop; straight to the Shedd.

stops.via: To Museum Campus; park at Soldier Field North Garage.
stops.name: Shedd Aquarium
stops.addr: Shedd Aquarium, 1200 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL
stops.note: Tickets for 9 AM entry; be inside by 9:30. Lunch on Museum Campus around 11:30.

stops.name: Field Museum
stops.addr: Field Museum, 1400 S Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL
stops.note: Browse (Sue the T. rex) until the timed Pokémon Fossil Exhibit entry at 3:30 PM. Out about 5:30, then drop Michael in Hermosa.

stops.title: Chicago → home
stops.note: Return the rental and eat dinner past security. AA 3054, ORD 9:00 PM → SFO 11:58 PM.
stops.navTo: O'Hare International Airport Rental Car Center
